topic: Why I started a second company
content:
My first startup was acqui-hired. Everyone said congratulations. I felt like I had quit halfway.

Two years later I started Saltmarsh Labs, mostly to finish the sentence.

The second time is not easier. You just recognise the hard parts sooner.

Every founder wants to hire a salesperson early.

I did the first 40 demos myself. By demo 30 the pitch was boring to me and finally clear to customers.

That is the moment to hire, not before.

topic: Our first price was too low
content:
1/ Driftwood launched at 9 euros per user per month.

2/ Customers who paid it did not use it. Customers who asked for invoices did.

3/ We moved to team pricing. Fewer sign-ups, better customers.

4/ A low price attracts people who are not sure they have the problem.
